breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to use the actual varying bending moment distribution M(x) = P(L − x) for 0 ≤ x ≤ L, rather than the incorrect constant peak moment M = PL over the full span. It explicitly states to 'Set up the actual internal bending moment distribution for a cantilever with an end point load as a function of x,' which aligns with the ground truth prompt and eliminates the erroneous constant-moment assumption from the incomplete prompt.
